TerraTec Press Release, 02.10.2001 Download Press Release, Word 6.0 Format return

That's easy: Cameo Connect You are already using a common FireWire-controller? You've got a free internal plug on your card? You want to use it efficiently? Then, take a look at the new Cameo Connect. This new device not only activates the internal FireWire plug, but also transfers it to the front side of your computer. Connecting a camcorder is now very easy. Cameo Connect will in stores between October and November. And even more: The problematic power supply of external components via the PCI-Bus is now ensured by the power adapter plug of the front module, which can equally take 3 ½“ devices. The replaceable spare front screen even allows you to install exchange disk drives. TerraTec also offers the new Cameo 600DV, another video cutting solution for comfortable and professional video editing, as this product already includes the Cameo Connect front module.
